subject: Post-call: Audit log export format & PII access traces (Finovate)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Audit log export format & PII access traces (Finovate)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery call regarding your audit/logging requirements: 

- Red flags you raised: need for per-user access traces to PII, exportable audit exports for quarterly audits, and proof of retention policy enforcement for 25 months.
- Action items we took: Monica to confirm what fields you need on export; Security (Ben) to provide a small anonymized sample export and describe our export formats (CSV/S3) and retention controls; Marissa to surface any contract language needed for retention SLA.

Questions we asked you to confirm:
1) Are the required columns exactly: actor_user_id, actor_email, resource_type, resource_id, action, timestamp_utc, ip_address, request_id, retention_tag?
2) Do you prefer an S3-delivered daily export or ad-hoc zipped CSV bundles for evidence requests?

Next steps:
- Sarah to confirm required columns and retention proof format by EOD 10/21.
- Ben will send a redacted sample audit export and a short README with column defs and example queries.
- Monica/Marissa will follow up on any contract language after we validate the sample.

Attachments: we will produce a small CSV sample and S3 delivery instructions once Sarah confirms the columns.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finovate.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Payments Security <payments-security@finovate.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit log export format & PII access traces (Finovate)

Thanks Monica — quick clarifications so Ben can build the sample correctly: 

- Columns: yes, exact set we look for is actor_user_id, actor_email, resource_type, resource_id, action, timestamp_utc, ip_address, request_id, pii_flag, pii_field_list, retention_tag. 
- pii_flag should be a boolean (true if the action touched any PII). pii_field_list should be pipe-delimited names of PII fields (e.g., ssn|dob|email).
- Retention proof: we need a CSV sample plus a short statement on retention enforcement (audit of deletions/retention policy runs) that we can include in our third-party audit pack.
- Delivery: S3 daily export is preferred for automation; ad-hoc zip is fine for one-offs.

Also: can you confirm whether logs include both service-account activity (system processes) and end-user console/API actions? We need to be able to filter them.

Appreciate it — Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Compliance | Finovate Payments
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finovate.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Audit log export format & PII access traces (Finovate)

Ben — forwarding Sarah's column list and delivery preference. Can you prepare: 
1) One redacted CSV sample (5 rows) that follows the column order Sarah requested. Use synthetic values but keep types realistic.
2) A README (short bullet list) describing: export cadence, S3 folder layout, retention lifecycle (25 months), and how to filter system/service-account vs user actions.
3) A short note we can drop into their audit pack describing how retention enforcement is logged (retention job run id, deletion records).

Target: have the sample + README uploaded to our secure S3 link and a one-page note by end of day 10/21 so Sarah can include it. If you need more time flag it.

Thanks — Monica
(On behalf of Sales)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Audit log export format & PII access traces (Finovate)

Monica / Sarah — attaching the redacted sample and the export README to this thread. 

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_audit_sample_20261021.csv (CSV, 2 KB) — 5 synthetic rows, fields: actor_user_id, actor_email, resource_type, resource_id, action, timestamp_utc, ip_address, request_id, pii_flag, pii_field_list, retention_tag
- s3-export-instructions.pdf (PDF, 120 KB) — delivery path, lifecycle rules, encrypt-at-rest notes, and IAM role example for read-only deliveries

Key notes:
- The export includes an actor_type column internally (system vs user) but we populate resource_type and action in the CSV for their immediate needs. We can expose actor_type on request.
- Retention: logs are retained 25 months by default for accounts on enterprise plan; deletion records are emitted to a deletion_audit topic and included in monthly retention-run exports. We included a sample deletion record with deletion_run_id and timestamp in the README.
- Format: daily S3 prefix per account (s3://rwi-exports/finovate-payments/YYYY/MM/DD/redwood_audit.csv.gz). Files are gzipped CSVs with UTF-8 encoding.

Sarah — please confirm that this format meets your needs or let us know any extra fields to add. If you'd like a weekly aggregated view or a BigQuery-friendly export, we can include that in a follow-up.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
